title: Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG Skull Mariner Pharaoh's Servant PSV-092 1st Edition Common
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG card features the Skull Mariner, a Warrior creature with 1600 attack and 900 defense. It is a 1st Edition Common card from the Pharaoh's Servant set, with card number PSV-092. The card is manufactured by Konami and is a Normal type card.

In addition, the card has some interesting features such as its rarity, game, and set. It is a great addition to any CCG Individual Cards or Collectible Card Games collection. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this unique piece!
